name: documentation-craft
description: Always-on documentation structure/mechanics/prose discipline. Top-priority principle: collapse to the smallest unit (word/phrase/clause/sentence/paragraph) that still carries the full idea, applied recursively — this outranks the other five. The rest: track cross-file edit recommendations as actions, verify link integrity by script after moves/renames (re-checking every touched file), recognize a cross-unit request as a new information-grain category, place general system knowledge in the producer's repo, and keep bug-fix comments short with audit evidence moved elsewhere.

source.title: Documentation Craft Baseline
source.relationship: Distilled from sessions where an in-prose recommendation to edit another file was never tracked and got lost, a file move corrupted unrelated links via an over-broad find/replace, a cross-cutting follow-up request was nearly forced into a single existing document instead of becoming its own category, producer/consumer documentation was split by where the need arose rather than by generality, verbose user-facing docs went unpruned, and an inline bug-fix comment duplicated phrasing between its 'before' and 'after' halves.
